header: sprintf's floating-point conversion (%e %f %g %E %G): copies the argument (10 bytes with the L flag, flags bit 7, else 8), formats it with Sprintf_FormatFloat and adds the length to the output count. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: audio/sprintf_core.s:1058 `bit 7, wa` -- L flag (set by Sprintf_CheckLengthLL)
spelling: the argument sizes are spelled `lda xbc, (P2CR:8)` / `lda xbc, (P2:8)`: they load the constants 10 and 8 (SFR equates P2CR = 0x0A, P2 = 0x08 used as numbers)

why_refused: A one-instruction tail call (`jr PanelTlv_ResolvePartCompanions`), i.e. a separate C function whose whole body calls the worker. Its 7 callers use it exactly as the 4 direct callers of the worker use the worker (all with `call`, so its comment 'for callers outside its calr reach' is wrong); nothing distinguishes a meaning for the wrapper, and any name would be an alias of PanelTlv_ResolvePartCompanions.
evidence: audio/audio_control_engine.s:4290 `call	PanelTlv_ResolvePartCompanions` -- a direct caller of the worker in the same file
